$comment: Go arm: go/coordinator (docs/designs/fleet-stack.md#trial-slice-l1). Commands run with sh from the worktree root. GOCACHE is per worktree (go/.cache) so clean gives a real cold build without touching the user's cache; modules come from the shared GOMODCACHE (setup downloads them). go generate runs go/gen, which writes the host protocol types from contracts/host-protocol.schema.json.
check: cd go && export GOCACHE=$PWD/.cache && go generate ./... && go vet ./...
build: cd go && export GOCACHE=$PWD/.cache && go generate ./... && go vet ./... && go build -o bin/fleet-coordinator ./coordinator
